about: Capture-time provenance for docs/screens/*.png (#335). One row per shot, written by the session that took the pixels: sha256/canvas are properties of the bytes, origin/install/url/seed/level/layout/sampleRate/build are properties of the instrument and cannot be recovered from the PNG afterwards. `node tools/recap.js check` verifies each row against the file it addresses and against every other row of the same (seed, level, sampleRate); the vocabulary, the route verdicts and the audio-draw rule live in tools/recap.js, not here.
plan: Shared by all six shots and recorded in README.md's capture block: window 1440x763 on the deployed build at ?dev=1&seed=60, DEV.boot(); DEV.freeze(true); DEV.tick(30), then DEV.cam(...) and one DEV.tick(1) per shot, vitals pinned at 100, the level's own hostiles cleared (never DEV.clear()), level banner taken down with banner('', 0). A frozen clock does not stop S.t, so these frames are reproducible by statistics and never by md5. **One term this plan did not record: the audio device.** A live boot advances the seeded stream through SND.init's noise buffer before the generator runs, so one seed deals one level per sample rate (#404, and the rule the tool prints as HW_WHY). These six captures read no SND.ac.sampleRate, so every row carries `sampleRate: null`, `check` prints each one as a device-scoped deal, and the binding below is per-machine: it says this frame is what ?dev=1&seed=60 dealt on the capture's audio device, not that every machine deals it. `STRICT=1 node tools/recap.js check` gates the missing term. A capture that reads the rate turns its own row into a cross-machine binding with no change to the tool.

shots.note: Deal transcribed from README.md's capture block, which names all six shots as one route: the deployed page opened at ?dev=1&seed=60, build proved by eval-visible code markers, every deployed js blob md5-identical to the tree at ce9d39d. layout is that block's DEV.layoutSig() for the deal. Pose: one posed grunt 6 m out on the camera's own band (a posed body added with DEV.spawn, never DEV.clear, which would leave 0 LEFT on the HUD).

Same route as level0-spawn; see that row for where each field was recorded. Shot 8be1f96 is the one whose caption names black air above the four risers - the reason #333 reopened, and the reason this artifact exists.

The reference shot for the block: the route and every deal field in these six rows are transcribed from README.md's capture block (deployed build, ?dev=1&seed=60, DEV.layoutSig 735688443, js blobs md5-identical to ce9d39d) rather than re-measured here. #335 measured this route: reloading the same URL read DEV.seed 60 and layout 735688443 on both loads, which is what makes origin+install=url-open a binding route.

Re-taken at cd191ca (#388, seventh frame for this seat), and this time the pixels are a capture, not a re-label: the previous take measured that #408 - an authored lamp's pool scaled to the plan it stands in - reaches this hand-authored seat, so no caption could keep these bytes current. That is the whole subject of #388 and it is settled here the only way it can be, by drawing the frame from the page that serves main. This row is addressed to the build the pixels were DRAWN at, which is a fact of the capture and not of any tree that later merges it: the page that served this shutter ran index.html 44b7f0ca over js/40_render.js 7942de4b, js/90_dev.js c36909c9, js/00_core.js ac12ee35, js/13_mesh.js f222d5ec, js/20_level.js bcf4ad4f and js/10_assets.js 3f00716c, read off the wire at capture time. The row deliberately says NOTHING about what the js/ blobs of a merged or current tree hash to - a docs-only PR ships whatever main's renderer is at merge time, so that sentence is false the moment any js/ file lands and it has arrived false four cycles running. What is claimed instead is one sentence and one render: these bytes came off the deployed page at cd191ca, and at this caption's own seat SEAT=1.5,2.5,0.6 node tools/view.js scene 3 renders mean 48.9 on this branch's js/ where the build these bytes replaced renders 49.5, so the term this take is made of is in the tree and in the page alike. Route is unchanged and is the URL itself: headless Chromium opened this row's url at a 1440x763 device-metrics override at scale 1 and, once the page reported ready, ran DEV.boot(); startLevel(3, true); banner('', 0); DEV.freeze(true); DEV.tick(30); P.hp = 100; DEV.cam(1.5, 2.5, floorAt(1.5, 2.5), 0.60, 0); DEV.tick(1), leaving the level's own 4 hostiles standing, then the game's own resume() plus one DEV.tick(1) if S.mode was not 'play', and re-read S.mode immediately before the shutter - S.mode read 'play' on both runs. Screenshot re-encoded as colour type 2 by tools/png_rgb.js (--check reports type 2 1440x763, no alpha, so the recap decoder reads its channels in the order the README states). THE DEAL MOVED, and it is recorded rather than chased: DEV.layoutSig() read 3233039185 on BOTH runs at this build, where the row this take replaces carried 2733654509 on all three of its runs at ed5faf4. The difference is visible in the frame - one panel of the TECH wall draws blue TECH here where that take's deal drew mossy stone - which is pickWallTex drawing from a different point in the seeded stream, the same finding README.md's capture block keeps and #420 owns: startLevel generates from wherever the stream has reached, so the deal is a property of the run and of the build that ran it, not of the url. Same room, same geometry, different wall panel, and this row states it instead of re-running until the old number comes back. Against the bytes this row replaces (c97a5077, drawn at ed5faf4): mean 50.60 -> 50.14, thirds 41.82 / 58.88+ / 50.82 -> 41.16 / 58.48 / 50.83, channels 49.8 / 51.1 / 47.7 -> 49.2 / 50.7 / 47.5, 0 rows below luma 24 in both. 67,001 of 1,098,720 px move by more than 2 luma (6.10 %: 30,843 / 35,889 / 269 by thirds), mean |delta| over those px 11.58, worst 111, 1,027 px over 50, bbox x 188-1439 x y 0-760 - the frame, not one bright patch. Two causes move them, #408's lamp pool and this run's deal, and a single page capture cannot separate them, so this row does not try; what it measures is the floor. Two untouched runs of the route at this build differ in 3,193 of 1,098,720 px (0.29 %), worst 6 in one channel, both reading layout 3233039185 - so 0.29 % is route noise and the 6.10 above is the move. By band, old -> new: rows 140-180 (the 4.00 plane) 44.66 -> 43.84, rows 300-330 (far ceiling past the level edge) 38.84 -> 38.27, rows 317-444 (the wall-top band) 66.96 -> 65.65, rows 400-600 (lit floor) 64.63 -> 64.34, and the wall's own patch x 660-1295 x y 340-422 83.18 -> 81.93, which is the panel that changed material rather than the light. props 9, lights 7, sr 44100, DECOR and FIX_DEP {DOOR 0.12, PIPE 0.10, STRIPE 0.03, VENT 0.08, RACK 0.20, TANK 0.24, BOARD 0.06} as before, and DEV.state().gnd reads jit 1, jitMinPx 48, light 1, ax 1, axMin 1.5, filt 1, ramp 1, far 1, fade 1, mipax 1, mipar 4, so #19's blend and #400's stood-off fixture are both still terms of these pixels. SND.ac.sampleRate read 44100, so this row is a cross-machine binding where the other five are device-scoped. The durable form of the sentence above - a caption that cannot go false when main moves - is #395; pinning the stream before startLevel so a re-take is a fact of the url is #420.
